svg.title: DaoCloud Open Source Portfolio
svg.desc: DaoCloud open source portfolio: 38 projects grouped into AI models and inference, GPU and scheduling, orchestration and runtime, lifecycle and delivery, networking and service mesh, storage and data, observability and operations, and testing and image distribution. Badges mark how DaoCloud participates.
svg.text: THE PORTFOLIO: From cloud native infrastructure to AI compute and inference
incl. projects started by DaoCloud staff

text.tspan: Each project is categorized once by its primary mode of participation. The count includes tools, Kubernetes subprojects, projects initiated by DaoCloud staff, and one archived project; it is not the company-wide project total.

Self-initiated = founded by DaoCloud; Deep contributor = maintainer / approver / substantial contributions; Co-initiated = jointly founded. Co-initiation does not imply current maintainer affiliation.

+ marks Dynamo, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, and KWOK, categorized per the Feishu initiation list; Merbridge is a CNCF Sandbox project and is kept but marked archived after more than a year without updates; Knoway and kasmcloud were removed for the same reason.
Categories follow primary use case and do not imply dependency relationships.
